observations: The recorder forwarded each real I2C_RDWR call unchanged and logged requests and responses.
The I2C expander at address 0x20 returned 0xfb for register 0x01 during mute-first startup.
The donor service completed startup and reported MCU application version 000116.
The capture contains exactly 40121 four-byte SPI requests totaling 160484 bytes.
The concatenated transmit payload exactly equals dsp-img.ldr after reversing the bit order of every byte.
Another 23 one-byte SPI transfers followed the image download.
The donor service received EVENT_DSP_BOOTUP, and the amplifier and DAC were remuted after capture.

safety: The capture ran from the checksum-gated RAM-only platform.
No NAND filesystem was mounted and no persistent storage command was issued.
The closed enclosure was not opened or electrically probed.
The shim records and forwards existing userspace ioctls; it does not synthesize responses in record mode.
